detail: Full summary: My initial H1b detector over-counted: the >80-char 'sentence fragment' heuristic flags legitimate long option strings written via the structured path. Inspecting 185 flagged dogfood decisions, the first several were well-formed with real reason_rejected text. The unambiguous signal is reason_rejected === 'Not chosen' alone: 1100/1226 in field (89.7%) and 164/258 dogfood (63.6%). H1b holds strongly on that signal; the fragment heuristic added only ~2 points and should not be trusted.
